description: This is my first time creating a Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition. It includes basic farming-related features, and when using a hoe to continuously harvest crops and replant them, you can hold down a designated key to do so (covering up to a 9x9-block area - just pour a bucket of water in the center).

mods.name: TheTidengFrastMod_ChainMining
mods.description: This is an example description! Tell everyone what your mod is about!

releases.notes:
Minecraft version 1.21.6

Features:
- Chain Mining: hold ` to scan connected blocks, left-click to break them all
- Chain Tilling: hold ` + right-click with a hoe to till farmland in a radius
- Chain Planting: hold ` + right-click with seeds to plant crops in a radius
- Chain Harvesting + Auto-Replant: hold ` + left-click mature crops with a hoe
- Smart HUD: shows active status, block count, and tool compatibility
- Wireframe outline: visual preview of targeted blocks
- Supports ores, logs, leaves, stone, dirt, grass, flowers, and all crops

Fix in v1.5.23:
- Fixed crash on startup caused by leftover Mixin reference in mixins.json
